about: Old PRs whose issues were confirmed by a reviewer or by the fix that followed. A finding catches an expected issue when it names the same file (and a line within 25, when one is given) and its text carries one of the words. On a clean case every real finding counts as a false alarm.

expect.what: job_log reads a whole job log into memory before cutting the tail
the CI-order test reads source text instead of running _hare_once
AGENTS.md still says a pending check means hold
says neither Dockerfile installs searchts from PyPI, but demo/Dockerfile does (needs repo context)
the reviews read stops at the first 100
readline has no size limit, so one endless line is read whole
a non-{ tail is still concatenated, and extract_json keeps the later, shorter findings list
a resolved thread keyed by path only marks every finding on the file
hop parsing only matches a backticked Models row, missing older notes
AGENTS.md says the ledger rewrites a block it does not
HARE.md says resolving or editing drops a rule, but scores are issue comments
the 17 s Flash-Lite note ran from the base script, not the PR's streaming code
AGENTS.md still names the old chain order
the PLAN bullet still says Space Bunny is last on Nous
